Loupe's brand mark. The logo square and the brand name, as the sidebar, the sign-in pages and the marketing pages draw them.

```jsx
<BrandMark />
<BrandMark size="sm" />
<BrandMark markOnly />
```

Sizes: `sm`, `md`. The mark draws the brand name itself, so never pass a label or children. The component emits the real `lp-brand` classes of the app.
